name: WWT Llanelli Play Areas
description: Several play areas: Explore, with ropes and balance beams over the swamp, the Swan's Nest Maze, Water Vole City's banks and tunnels, Wiggly Wood for den building and the Flamingo Bay play area by the visitor centre. Many are gated. Open 9.30am to just before 5pm (4.30pm November to February).
fee: Non-members pay to visit; see the centre's tickets page for prices. WWT members get in free at all 10 wetland centres.
